sv.title: ”Min fru var otrogen – vill låtsas att allt är bra”
sv.summary: Frun var otrogen men vill nu inte prata om det. ”Är i fritt fall – vad ska jag göra?” undrar maken.

en.title: ”My wife was unfaithful – wants to pretend everything is fine”
en.summary: Wife was unfaithful but now does not want to talk about it. ”I'm in free fall – what should I do?” asks the husband.
